Our story

From a message to a marriage

✈
3rd June 2021

The First Message

It started with her comment in a Facebook group, and me sending a message that very same day—two people a border apart, simply saying hello.

2021-2022

Getting to know each other

Over the next few months, we talked whenever life allowed. Small check-ins slowly turned into long conversations, shared stories, and an effortless comfort with each other.

16th July 2022

Face to face, at last

After a year of screens and time zones, we finally met. In the years since, the distance became just a flight away, and we made the journey between India and Nepal again and again.

0visits between India and Nepal
Across Nepal

Wherever the road led

From hiking & wandering all across the Kathmandu Valley, to escaping to Kurintar, to trekking in Langtang, every trip gave us new stories to tell.

February 2025

Meeting the family in Mumbai

Shova came to Mumbai, met Chirag’s parents and grandmother, and shared a wonderful family trip together. It already felt like home.

3 December 2026

The wedding

Two families and two cultures come together as we tie the knot at Ram Mandir, Battisputali, Kathmandu.
